metadata.title: Isolated Flat Points and $C^2$-Robustness of the No Focal Points Property
metadata.abstract: We prove a local stability criterion for the no focal points property on compact Riemannian surfaces. More precisely, if a smooth metric $g$ has non-positive Gaussian curvature and its zero-curvature set is finite, then $g$ belongs to the $C^2$-interior of the set of metrics without focal points. Thus, every sufficiently small $C^2$-perturbation of $g$ still has no focal points, although arbitrarily small perturbations may create regions of positive Gaussian curvature. By Ruggiero's characterization of the $C^2$-interior of the set of metrics without conjugate points, all metrics in the resulting neighborhood are Anosov. We also show that, starting from any hyperbolic metric on a compact surface, one can prescribe an arbitrary finite set as the zero set of the Gaussian curvature of a smooth conformal non-positively curved metric. These metrics can be approximated smoothly by negatively curved metrics, so they lie on the boundary of the negatively curved regime while remaining interior points of the no-focal-points regime. The proof of the stability theorem combines uniform local convexity, Gulliver's bound on the length of geodesic segments contained in small balls, and an inductive argument on the Riccati equation that controls successive passages through the regions where positive curvature may appear.

analysis.workSummary: 研究零曲率点有限的非正曲率紧曲面，证明其具有允许正曲率扰动的无焦点邻域，并构造指定零点的例子。
techniques: 局部凸性与测地线段长度估计
无焦点与 Anosov 判据
analysis.breakthrough: 把带有限退化点的非正曲率几何与稳定的双曲动力学联系起来。
analysis.limitations: 紧二维背景、零点有限性及 C2 邻域重要，不能推广为一般高维非正曲率流形的结论。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。
